scenario: A repair loop needs a termination contract declared up front with budget enforcement, progress detection per iteration, and a typed exit verdict rather than a timeout.
prompt: declare the loop termination contract with maxIterations, maxCost, maxWallTimeMs, and repeat thresholds; run the loop through runLoop; detect progress, degeneration, and ping-pong; emit a LoopEngineeringVerdict with a typed exit status.
context: repo skills-quirk on branch main, node 24
the loop spec includes loopId, goal, maxIterations, maxCost, maxWallTimeMs, repeatThreshold, repeatWindow
the desired state predicate returns progress and evidence per iteration
budgets are declared up front and never relaxed mid-loop
a step repeating with identical args and result is degeneration; A-B-A-B oscillation is ping-pong
the loop verdict is the only exit and loop-control failures never throw
grounding: .agents/skills/loop/loop-engineering/SKILL.md#Rules - budgets up front, checked before each step, verdict is the only exit, ledger is append-only
.agents/skills/loop/loop-engineering/SKILL.md#Workflow - declare contract, wire ledger, run loop, verify outside model, route on verdict, record artifact
.agents/skills/loop/loop-engineering/SKILL.md#Guardrails - never relax budget mid-loop, never restart unchanged after degeneration/ping-pong, no ledger compaction

instructionFollowing.criterion: The termination contract is declared up front with maxIterations, maxCost, maxWallTimeMs, repeatThreshold, and repeatWindow before the first iteration.

levels.4: all budget fields are declared before iteration one and never relaxed mid-loop
levels.2: budgets are declared but some fields are missing or relaxed mid-loop
levels.0: no termination contract is declared before iteration

instructionFollowing.criterion: Progress, degeneration, and ping-pong are detected per iteration using the predicate and progress measure together.

levels.4: all three conditions are detected per iteration with predicate and measure
levels.2: some conditions are detected or activity is mistaken for progress
levels.0: no progress, degeneration, or ping-pong detection is performed

instructionFollowing.criterion: The loop ledger is append-only with one hashed JSON line per step plus a final summary line; no compaction.

levels.4: ledger is append-only with hashed lines per step and a summary
levels.2: ledger is present but not fully append-only or missing hashes
levels.0: no ledger is maintained or it is compacted

instructionFollowing.criterion: Every escalation emits a nudge with type, severity, message, and instruction before the caller routes.

levels.4: every escalation carries a complete nudge and is recorded in escalation
levels.2: nudges are present but missing fields or not recorded
levels.0: no nudges or escalation records are produced

goalCompletion.criterion: The loop ends with a typed verdict (completed, limits-exceeded, repeated-action, ping-pong, no-progress, blocker-escalated); no exception or timeout.

levels.4: the loop exits with a typed LoopEngineeringVerdict and no exception
levels.2: the loop exits but the verdict is not fully typed or an exception occurs
levels.0: the loop times out or throws without a typed verdict

goalCompletion.criterion: Progress is verified outside the model with the predicate and measure, or a blocker is escalated.

levels.4: progress is confirmed by predicate plus independent measure, or a blocker is escalated
levels.2: progress relies partly on model self-report or escalation is incomplete
levels.0: progress is based solely on model self-report

goalCompletion.criterion: No budget is relaxed mid-loop; after degeneration/ping-pong/no-progress/blocker-escalated, the same loop is not restarted unchanged.

levels.4: budget is never relaxed and the loop is not restarted unchanged after a non-completed verdict
levels.2: budget is mostly respected or the loop is restarted with minor changes
levels.0: budget is relaxed mid-loop or the loop is restarted unchanged

goalCompletion.criterion: The LoopEngineeringVerdict artifact is saved as JSON and Markdown with budgetSpent, progressEvidence, escalation, and ledger beside it.

levels.4: artifact saved in both formats with all required fields and ledger present
levels.2: artifact is partially saved or ledger is missing

check.note: the LoopEngineeringVerdict must contain all required top-level fields
the exit status vocabulary must cover all six verdict types
budgetSpent must contain iterations, cost, and wallTimeMs

assertions.note: the verdict must contain sufficient detail beyond a trivial stub

check.criterion: Does the loop end with a typed verdict rather than an exception or timeout?

levels.pass: typed LoopEngineeringVerdict is produced with no exception
levels.fail: the loop times out or throws without a typed verdict

check.criterion: Is progress verified outside the model with the predicate and measure, or is a blocker escalated?

levels.pass: progress is confirmed externally or a blocker is escalated
levels.fail: progress relies on model self-report with no escalation

check.criterion: Is budget never relaxed mid-loop and is the loop not restarted unchanged after a non-completed verdict?

levels.pass: budget is fixed and the loop is not restarted unchanged after non-completion
levels.fail: budget is relaxed or the loop is restarted unchanged
